publication: ILFORD DELTA 400 PROFESSIONAL Technical Information, November 2018

conditions.agitation: intermittent; four inversions in the first 10 seconds and first 10 seconds of each further minute
conditions.format: publication does not identify a separate format for this characteristic curve
conditions.exposure_axis: relative log exposure; no absolute exposure/ISO calibration inferred
conditions.density: total density as plotted, no additional base or fog
conditions.shoulder: Published exposure extent does not establish measured Dmax; constant numerical endpoint extension only.

characteristic.reconstruction_grid: 257 uniform relative-log-exposure knots interpolated from monotone ink trace; raw constraints retain original pixel abscissae

sensitivity.calibration: piecewise linear through printed sensitivity ticks and plot baseline interpreted as zero; no tungsten-SPD division

source_raster.curation: threshold 128; longest thick ink run excluding grid; bounded monotone reconstruction

reconstruction.method: Least-squares clamped uniform cubic B-spline fitted to the retained samples with nondecreasing controls and fixed endpoints; limited complexity within the recorded density-reading allowance. Samples retain the graph trace, not interpolation knots.

sensitivity.definition: Sensitivity ordinate interpreted as linear relative response with zero at the plot baseline, not logarithmic. Wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850 K) retained as test condition; no source-SPD division or photon/energy conversion inferred. Virtual gray removes absolute scale. Manufacturer radiometric calibration not established.
